public class textdocumentanalysis {
    static int countInsideBraces = 0, longestWord = 0;

    public static int countWords(String str) {
        str = str.replaceAll("_", " ");
        str = str.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        String[] words = str.split(" ");
        if (words.length == 1 && words[0].isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }
        return words.length;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline
        String input = scanner.nextLine();
        
        List<Integer> bracePositions = new ArrayList<>();
        bracePositions.add(-1);
        
        for (int idx = 0; idx < input.length(); idx++) {
            char ch = input.charAt(idx);
            if (ch == '(' || ch == ')') {
                bracePositions.add(idx);
            }
        }
        
        int pairIndex = 1;
        int wordCountInside = 0;
        int maxWordLength = 0;
        StringBuilder outsideText = new StringBuilder();
        
        while (pairIndex < bracePositions.size() - 1) {
            int openPos = bracePositions.get(pairIndex);
            int closePos = bracePositions.get(pairIndex + 1);
            
            String insideContent = input.substring(openPos + 1, closePos);
            wordCountInside += countWords(insideContent);
            
            String outsideSegment = input.substring(bracePositions.get(pairIndex - 1) + 1, openPos);
            outsideText.append("_").append(outsideSegment);
            
            pairIndex += 2;
        }
        
        String finalOutsideSegment = input.substring(bracePositions.get(bracePositions.size() - 1) + 1);
        outsideText.append("_").append(finalOutsideSegment);
        
        String cleanedOutside = outsideText.toString()
                .replaceAll("_", " ")
                .trim()
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        
        String[] outsideWords = cleanedOutside.split(" ");
        for (String word : outsideWords) {
            if (word.length() > maxWordLength) {
                maxWordLength = word.length();
            }
        }
        
        System.out.print(maxWordLength + " " + wordCountInside);
    }
}
